sloka: वानराश्चापरे भीमा राक्षसैरपरैः सह ।द्वन्द्वं समीयुर्बहुधा युद्धाय बहुभिः सह ।। ६.४३.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: vānarāścāpare bhīmā rākṣasairaparaiḥ saha ।dvandvaṁ samīyurbahudhā yuddhāya bahubhiḥ saha ।। 6.43.15 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.
